story: May Bach began with a simple refusal: to treat extraordinary cars as inventory. Each one is sought out, inspected and admitted — then given the space to be seen properly.
Behind the glass on [Street], the floor is marble, the light is low, and the collection changes quietly through the year.
You are welcome to walk in. Or to have us close the doors for you.
